center.label: Standing on the laid centre rune
center.explanation: Original: two further calls both return false with no key queued; only the Borg's own (excluded) grid has a distance, so no outlying grid is chosen. Corrected: the first further call flows toward a ring grid at distance 1 and queues a step (key 51, south-east).
